bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
c=deploy-gaybbs-1
live=$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.Image}}')
new=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:applicant-live-48134d4 --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$live" = "$new" || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.State.Status}}')" = running || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.RestartCount}}')" = 0 || exit 73
docker logs --since 10m "$c" 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY || exit 74
docker inspect "$c" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -qx 'GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED=enabled' || exit 76
docker exec "$c" sh -c 'test -s /app/gaybbs.mjs' || exit 77
echo GAYBBS_RUNTIME_IMAGE_AND_WORKER_PASS
echo SOURCE_IMAGE_TAG=applicant-live-48134d4
echo RUNNING=YES
echo RESTART_COUNT=0
echo NOTIFICATION_WORKER_ENABLED=YES
